description: Evaluation phrases for the Art. 5 Compliance detectors CMP-01 to CMP-04. Each entry is { detector, phrase, expected }, plus "added" on a phrase written after the 3.0 evaluation, which the report marks as new: "3.1" for the 3.1 additions and "4.2" for the 4.2 additions. expected is 'positive' for a paraphrase of a prohibited request that deliberately does not reuse the detector's example wording, or 'near-miss' for a legitimate request on a nearby topic, including the uses Art. 5 itself exempts, that must not fire. detector names the detector a near-miss was written for, but near-misses are scored against all four detectors, since a legitimate request must not trip any of them; positives are scored against their named detector. The real-model evaluation uses the same High and Medium examples and cosine similarity as SemanticDetectorBase to set each detector's thresholds. ComplianceDetectorTests guards this shape. Each entry also has a split of 'fit' or 'heldout'. Tuning may read only fit phrases; heldout phrases are reported on and never used to set thresholds. Every phrase written before 4.2 is fit. The 4.2 additions were split about half and half per detector and label while they were written, and were committed before any evaluation run scored them. Counts: CMP-01 has 8 positives and 8 near-misses, CMP-02 7 positives and 11 near-misses, CMP-04 7 positives and 8 near-misses, 2 of each kind heldout; CMP-03 has 17 positives, 5 of them heldout, and 37 near-misses, 8 of them heldout.
